title: RecipeTin's Chicken & Gravy
ingredients: Chicken: 1.25kg bone-in chicken thighs, 15ml olive oil, 5g paprika, 2.5g garlic powder, 2.5g onion powder, 3g dried thyme, 6g salt, 1.5g pepper
Veg: 600g baby potatoes, 3 carrots, 1 red onion, 2 crushed garlic cloves, 22ml olive oil, 6g salt, 1.5g pepper
Gravy: 40g flour, 625ml beef stock, 5ml dark soy sauce, 2.5g black pepper
steps: Preheat oven to 200°C. Toss potatoes, carrots, onion, garlic, oil, salt, and pepper in a bowl, then pour into a 35x26cm roasting pan.
Coat chicken in oil and seasoning spices, then place neatly on top of the vegetables.
Whisk flour with 125ml beef stock until smooth, then whisk in remaining stock, soy sauce, and pepper. Pour into the pan edge.
Drizzle chicken with a little oil and bake for 45 minutes until browned and potatoes are tender.
Remove chicken to a plate, stir thawed peas into the pan to thicken the gravy and vegetables.
Divide vegetables and gravy between bowls, top with chicken, and serve.
